name: CoFoundersLab

sources.title: Homepage — 'largest startup community', 700k+ members, 'Join for free', optional /premium tier

requirements: Account registration required; joining is free ('Join for free'), with an optional Premium tier at /premium
This is a founder/advisor networking community — there is no product-submission form; presence = member profile + startup profile + posts in the feed
Fit: real founders/advisors; profile fields ask about skills, interests, location
preparation: Founder profile basics: name, photo, role, skills, location
Startup description/stage for the startup profile
workflow: Sign up at cofounderslab.com ('Join for free' / Login)
Complete the member profile (skills, interests, location, what you're looking for)
Add/claim your startup profile if the flow offers it
Post an intro in the community feed (batch-listed route cofounderslab.com/feed) linking the product where contextually allowed
watchFor: Not a directory — don't expect a crawlable product listing page; value is profile + feed presence
Premium upsell (/premium) gates some networking features
Link placement rules unknown — drive-by link drops in feeds often get flagged in founder communities
700k claimed members but feed engagement level unverified
countsAsLive: Your member/startup profile is publicly viewable at its cofounderslab.com URL and any feed post is visible to the community
unknowns: Whether profiles expose a dofollow website link
Premium tier pricing and which features it unlocks
Moderation policy for self-promotional feed posts
